All done. The fix is complete and verified:

**Root cause:** In `parseMatcherDefinitions` (caddyconfig/httpcaddyfile/httptype.go:1441), when a named matcher was defined as a single quoted token (backticks or heredoc, e.g. `` @g `{...} == 404` `` or `@g <<CEL ... CEL`), a synthetic `expression` token was created with only `File`/`Line` set. Tokens coming from snippets/imports carry an `imports` chain, and since the synthetic token had an empty one, `isNextOnNewLine` (caddyconfig/caddyfile/lexer.go:371) treated the expression as being on a new line — causing `d.NextArg()` to fail and the "wrong argument count or unexpected line ending after 'expression'" error.

**Fix:**
- Added `Token.Clone()` (deep copy preserving `imports`, `heredocMarker`, `snippetName`, etc.) in caddyconfig/caddyfile/lexer.go:359
- In `parseMatcherDefinitions`, the inserted `expression` token is now `d.Token().Clone()` with just the text replaced, so it keeps the same file/import-chain as the expression token

**Verification:**
- Reproduced the original error with a snippet + backtick Caddyfile before the fix; it now adapts correctly, as does the heredoc-in-snippet case
- `go test ./caddyconfig/...` and the `TestCaddyfileAdaptToJSON` integration suite (which includes `expression_quotes.caddyfiletest` with the snippet cases) all pass
- `gofmt` clean; the `modules/caddyhttp` test failure is an unrelated network timeout when fetching a test dependency
